checklist: Before you finish, check the code against this list: keep secrets out of code and out of the browser; check on the server that the signed-in user may perform each action and owns each record; accept only the fields the user is meant to set; validate and limit all input and use parameterised queries; limit how often expensive or public endpoints can be called; verify webhooks and uploads; store tokens and keys hashed or encrypted; never log secrets; and say in your reply what you added and what the user still has to set up.
placebo: Before you finish, check the code against this list: use clear and consistent names; keep functions short and focused; follow the existing style and folder layout; add comments where the intent is not obvious; show sensible empty and loading states in the interface; format dates and numbers consistently; keep the folder structure tidy; keep imports organised; write or update tests for new behaviour; keep the README accurate; avoid duplicated code; keep the change small and easy to review; and say in your reply what you changed and what the user still has to set up.
